name: Production Showcase
description: Every new production machine on one floor, stocked and wired: read the signs, press Start, send the bill.

text: MAIN SWITCH: off = machines No power, genset and lamps off
STOCK: creative fills these bins; survival builds them empty
Press Start on the console: all three refiners run
Cut this conveyor to see pieces drop
Line A's angles go in here: the press stamps brackets
Take a piece with F (aim at the one you want)
Line B (planks) meets line A at the join: one rack
Too narrow on purpose: aim the linking tool, wheel to widen
Narrow this conveyor (linking tool, wheel): a refusal
Send the bill: the Assembler makes these parts
Bill, then Send: the orders go out. Then Line, Start
F on the screen: order a part. It arrives in the tray
F on the station: pick Swing Arm Buggy, Start. Parts ride in
PANELS: sheet in at the white end, panels out at the orange
Send the bill: a hood, a fender and a kit hood are formed
F: design a panel; it is formed next door
MONITOR: the console's Data out wired to a display
MONITOR: any display works; it lays itself out
ORDERS BOARD: red lamp = Alarm (a machine waits or is out)

bill.panel: Formed Panel (hood 160x150 c14 r18 t20 steel)
Formed Panel (fender 140x45 c6 r45 t20 steel)
